overview_description.description: We are 4TiGO, The Truck Network. We have set out on a mission to empower the Indian goods transportation industry ecosystem through technology and the power of networking. 4TiGO provides a common technology platform complemented with Business Services for each and every participant in the ecosystem. The 4TiGO Network members interact, transact and manage the entire goods transportation lifecycle and business on the platform thereby enabling a quantum leap in Productivity, Efficiency & Customer Service.
